correctness.rationale: Normalization and common mean imply f-g=(1-z)^2[a+bz] exactly. With degree≤2, constant-sign difference imposes monotone ordering of all PGF iterates; with degree3 an interior unique sign change at c=-a/b forces at most one chronological reversal. For p0<q0, monotonicity proves no reversal while g iterates ≤c; g(c)>c iff its supercritical extinction fixed point rg>c. Then f(rg)>rg implies rf>rg and eventual reversed order. The exact witness f=(4+6z+5z³)/15, g=(5+9z²+z³)/15 shares mean7/5, and independent Fraction compositions gave differences -1/15,-77/3375,+5919069959/3113912109375 for generations1–3. This is a universal algebraic comparison, not inferred from finite enumerations.
